vjimc-2007-cat2-01.prompt: Construct a set $A\subset[0,1]\times[0,1]$ such that $A$ is dense in $[0,1]\times[0,1]$ and every vertical and every horizontal line intersects $A$ in at most one point.
vjimc-2007-cat2-01.answer: E.g. choose points one by one in the countably many rational open squares, each time avoiding the finitely many $x$- and $y$-coordinates used so far; or take $A=\{(\{n\sqrt2\},\{n\sqrt3\}):n\in\mathbb N\}$.

vjimc-2007-cat2-02.prompt:
Let $A$ be a real $n\times n$ matrix satisfying
$$A+A^t=I,$$
where $A^t$ denotes the transpose of $A$ and $I$ the $n\times n$ identity matrix. Show that $\det A>0$.
vjimc-2007-cat2-02.answer: $A=\frac12I+S$ with $S$ skew-symmetric; the eigenvalues of $S$ are $0$ or conjugate pairs $\pm ir$, so $\det A=\left(\tfrac12\right)^{n-2s}\prod\left(\tfrac14+r_k^2\right)>0$.

vjimc-2007-cat2-03.prompt:
Let $f:[0,1]\to\mathbb R$ be a continuous function such that $f(0)=f(1)=0$. Prove that the set
$$A:=\{h\in[0,1] : f(x+h)=f(x)\text{ for some }x\in[0,1]\}$$
is Lebesgue measurable and has Lebesgue measure at least $\frac12$.
vjimc-2007-cat2-03.answer: $A$ is compact; for every $h$, the function $g(x)=f(x+h)-f(x)$ taken cyclically (indices mod $1$) has a zero, so $h\in A$ or $1-h\in A$; hence $A\cup(1-A)=[0,1]$ and $2\lambda(A)\ge1$.

vjimc-2007-cat2-04.prompt:
Let $S$ be a finite set with $n$ elements and $\mathcal F$ a family of subsets of $S$ with the following property:
$$A\in\mathcal F,\ A\subseteq B\subseteq S\ \Longrightarrow\ B\in\mathcal F.$$
Prove that the function $f:[0,1]\to\mathbb R$ given by
$$f(t):=\sum_{A\in\mathcal F}t^{|A|}(1-t)^{|S\setminus A|}$$
is nondecreasing ($|A|$ denotes the number of elements of $A$).
vjimc-2007-cat2-04.answer: $f(t)$ is the probability that the random set $X_t=\{j: U_j<t\}$ ($U_j$ independent uniform on $[0,1]$) lies in $\mathcal F$; $X_{t_1}\subseteq X_{t_2}$ for $t_1<t_2$ and $\mathcal F$ is up-closed.
